content: Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sulegoed

Moisés Israel-dulemarga sogdebalid: “Bab-Dummad-Jehová be-dadganga we-yar-bemarga-ukoye-sogsadgi, be gudii gudmarsunnar, bemar, we-Igarmar-Mamaid be nue-dakdii gumalargebed, eba be ibsadii gumalargebed. A-yargi bemar dula-gudiidgi, wemar-Igargan-soglesadba bemar nue-nanadigued be imakmalo.

”Bela neggweburmar be suesokalidgi e-bab-dummaganse-gormalad-e-aila-matusurmalad bela be osulogoed. We-aila-matusurmalad yar-dummagangi-bukwad, yar-mullugangi-bukwad, degi, sapimar-bulamakwichid-urba-bukwad, bela be osulogoed.

”E-ibe e-bab-dummadga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailamar be earo, e-ibe e-akwamar-islidikmalad be mamarbalo. E-bab-dummad-bundor-Aseraʼye-nugad-e-wilubgan-sobarmalad be ogumako. E-bab-dummagan-e-wilubgan-sobarmalad be mamaro, degi, e-bab-dummagan-e-nug bela be elio.
”Bemardi, be-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼse-golegala, melle we-dulemar-e-bab-dummaganse-goleyob be gormalo.
Ar be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, bemar-danar-danar-bukwamalad-abargi neg sunonikoed, adi, agi e-nug naguega, egi gudii guegar. Bemar Bab-Jehováʼse-golegala, a-negse naoed.

content.text: Bemar a-negse be-Bab-Jehováʼga ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged be uknaoed,
Na be-itolegedba be ibmar-ukbiedba-ukoed be sedoed.

content: ”Agi, be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-asabin, be-gwenadganmala be mas gunmaloed. Na be arbasmaladgi be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová bemargi ise-nued-binsasadba be wergudmaloed.
Emi, anmar, war-wargwengi na e-dakedba igi ibmar-imakbukwa, deyobi, melle be a-yargi ibmar-imakbukwa gumalo.
”Ar amba yoo bemar obunnoged-negse dogmalad, amba yoo bemarga bemar-Bab-Dummad-Jehová ibmar-ukoye-soged uked.

Ar bemar Jordán-diwar obakoed. Degine, bemar-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-bemarga-yar-uknaidgi bemar bukwa gumaloed. Be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová be-isdarmalad-bemar-dikarba-bukwadgi obined bemar-imakoed. Agine, bemar dobsuli-bukwa gumaloed.
An bemarga bela-ibmar-sogsad, be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová e-nug-nasikega-neg-sunonikoedgi be uknonimaloed:

content.text: Bab-Jehováʼga ibmar-bur-nued-ukedseye be ise-sogar-sogsadi, a-neggi be uknonikoed.
Ar ade, Levita-dulemargardi bemarba nainu ega uklegosulid.

content: ”Nue salakarmar. Melle be Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged, neg-yogsaaledgi be ukmalo.
Unnila bia Bab-Jehová bemar-dadgan-ambe-gakabogwad-gwensakgi neg suoe, agi be ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged ukmaloed. Agi bela an bemarga Igar-uknaid be imakmaloed.

”Degi-inigwele, ar na be san-gunbiedba be-ibdurgan oburgoed. Degine, ar ibu-neggweburgi be gudiile, agi na be san-gunbiedba be gunnoed, Bab-Dummad-Jehová bega ibmar-uksadba be deyob imakoed. Be, Bab-Jehová-asabin swilidik gudiidibe, swilidik gudisurdibe, we-san sunna be gunnoed. We-sande, goe-san-gunneyob be gunnoed.
Degi-inigwele, be san-gunnalile, abebi be gunnosulid. Ar e-abedi, diiyob be napagi eogoed.
”Deginbali, be-neggweburmargi Bab-Dummadga be-ibmar-ambegi gwensak-uked (10%), be gunnosulid:
”A-ibmarmala, be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-neg-susadgi be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-asabin be gunnoed.
”Nue salakarmar. Ar we-napneggi be gudiidgine, melle be Levita-dule nue-akwesuli gumalo.
”Ar be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-bemarga-sogsadyob, bemarga be-yar-odummosale, geb agi be sokardibe: ‘An san gunbiendo.’ Ar be-abegedba be san gunnodo.

Ar be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová megega-na-neg-susadi, begi dikasur-sii be dakele, an bega Igar-uksadba sunna Bab-Jehová-bega-moli-bebe-nikad-uksad, bega-sibad-wawaadmar-uksad, degi, sibadmar-uksad, be oburgoed. Deginbali, ar be-neggweburgi san-gunbiedba be gunnoed.
We-sanmar be gunnalile, goe-sapurmar-e-san-gullegeyob be gunmaloed. Dule Bab-Jehová-asabin swilidik gudiidibe, swilidik gudisurdibe, we-san sunna gunnoed.
”Unnila an bega soged, san-abebiiddi be gunnosulid. Ar ade, abegi dula-gued danikid. Dula-gued-abegi-danikid, san-ebogwa melle be gunno.
Degisoggua, ibdurgan-e-abedi diiyob be napagi eogoed.
Melle be san-amba-abebiid gunno, adi, be yeer-itodii guega, degine, be-sorbali, be-mimmigan yeer-itodii gumogagar. Ar deyob, be Bab-Jehová-asabin ibmar-nued be imakoed, eba be ibsaoed.
”Ar be ibmar-Bab-Dummadga-nug-imaksaddi, degine, be Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-ukoye-sogsaddi, Bab-Jehová-na-neg-suoedse be sedoed.

Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailagi be be-Bab-Dummadga san, degi, e-abe, be ogumakar ukoed. Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-ukleged-e-abedi, be Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailagi eogoed. E-sandi, be gunmaloed.

”We-Igargan-an-bega-uknaid nue be itomalo, degine, eba nue be nanamalo. Ar bemar, be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-asabinni ibmar-nued imakdimalale, ibmar-innikii-imakdimalale, bemarga ibmar-nueganbi naoed. Deginbali, be-sorba be-mimmiganga, degibi degisadegu, ibmar-nueganbi-gumai gumogoed.”
Bab-Dummadgi-banguedgi sunmaklenaid
Moisés Israel-dulemarga sogdebalid: “Be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, bemar-yar-susokalidgi, bemar-wagab e-dulemar-bukwad obelononikile, degine, bela e-ibe be ibmar-susale,
nue salakarmar, melle be e-daedba damalo. Melle be weyob egisdii nanamalo: ‘We-dulemar, ¿igi e-bab-dummaganse gordamala? Adi, anmar deyob a-bab-dummaganse gormarmogagar.’

Mer be deyob-imakedgi binsamalo. Ar Bab-Jehová, we-dulemar e-bab-dummaganga ibmar-isgana-imaksamalad sae-daked. Ar we-dulemar, e-masmalase-bakar, degi, e-bunamalase-bakar e-bab-dummadga e-ibmar-ogumakleged-ailagi ogumakar imakdamalad.
”Bela an bega-Igargan-uknaidba be ibmar-imakdii nanamalo. Melle an-bega-Igar-uknaid be obulomalo. Melle be igarmar-nanaid abar-abar sogmarbalo.”
